exposure: elite athlete status (high-impact and low-impact sports)
elite athlete status (high-impact sports, low-impact sports)
outcome: length of the first stage of labor
length of the second stage of labor
cohort: Primiparous female elite athletes engaging in high-impact and low-impact sports compared with non-athletic controls
finding: Participation in competitive sports at the elite level was not associated with adverse delivery outcomes, including length of labor, the need for caesarean section during delivery, and severe perineal tears, except for a higher incidence of severe perineal tears in low-impact athletes compared to high-impact athletes.
mod_finding: Participation in competitive sports at the elite level was not associated with a need for caesarean section during delivery.
